title: can / could / be able to
recall: can, could va be able to farqi nima? O'tmishdagi bir martalik uddalashni qanday aytasiz?
formula: can / can't: hozirgi qobiliyat, ruxsat, imkoniyat
could: o'tmishdagi UMUMIY qobiliyat (I could swim at 5), muloyim so'rov, taxmin
be able to: boshqa zamonlarda (will be able to, have been able to); o'tmishdagi BIR MARTALIK uddalash — was able to / managed to

pairs.a: I could swim when I was six.
pairs.b: I was able to swim across the river yesterday.

en: I can swim.
I could read when I was five.
I was able to read when I was five.
When I was five, I could read.
I was able to solve the problem yesterday.
I managed to solve the problem yesterday.
I couldn't open the door.
I wasn't able to open the door.
Could you help me?
Could you help me, please?
Could you please help me?

items.uz: Kelasi yil ingliz tilida erkin gapira olaman.
en: Next year I'll be able to speak English fluently.
I'll be able to speak English fluently next year.
I will be able to speak English fluently next year.

items.uz: Men hech qachon gitara chalishni o'rgana olmaganman.
en: I've never been able to play the guitar.
I have never been able to learn the guitar.
You can't smoke here.
You cannot smoke here.
I couldn't sleep because of the noise.
I wasn't able to sleep because of the noise.
Everyone was able to get out of the fire.
Everyone managed to escape the fire.
Everyone was able to escape the fire.
It can't be true.
That can't be true.

items.uz: Erta kelsang, men bilan uchrasha olasan.
en: If you come early, you'll be able to meet me.
If you come early, you can meet me.
Can I come in?
May I come in?
Could I come in?
I can't see anything without my glasses.

items.uz: Bir necha urinishdan keyin u imtihondan o'ta oldi.
en: After several attempts, he was able to pass the exam.
He managed to pass the exam after several attempts.
After several tries, he managed to pass the exam.
Can you work without a computer?
Are you able to work without a computer?

items.uz: Haydashni bilmasdim, shuning uchun taksi oldim.
en: I couldn't drive, so I took a taxi.
I couldn't drive, so I got a taxi.
I can't come tomorrow.
I won't be able to come tomorrow.
I'm afraid we won't be able to get the money back.
I'm afraid we can't get the money back.

items.uz: Yangi telefon bilan suratga yaxshi tushira olaman.
en: I can take good photos with my new phone.

speak: Bolaligingizda nima qila olardingiz, hozir esa qila olmaysiz? (could / can't)
O'tmishdagi bitta qiyin vaziyat: qanday uddaladingiz? (was able to / managed to)
6 oydan keyin nimalarni qila olasiz? (will be able to)
